description: Free, no API key. Run a live store search for a candidate app name and report exact matches, close matches or none in that storefront. It does not check trademarks or reserved names.

country.description: Two-letter storefront code (e.g. us, gb, de). Defaults to us.

name.description: The candidate app name (2 to 50 characters).

platform.description: Store to read. Defaults to ios.

name: check_app_name
